Know About Our Dairy Farm & Our History

GreenMeadow Farm has been a family-owned and operated dairy and poultry farm since 1998. We are committed to providing our community with the freshest, highest-quality dairy products while maintaining the highest standards of animal welfare.

  • 100% Organic & Natural Products
  • Grass-Fed, Pasture-Raised Cows & Hens
  • No Hormones, No Antibiotics, No Additives
  • Same-Day Doorstep Delivery

Questions? We Have Answers

Everything families ask us before they order.

Do you deliver every day?

Yes. We deliver at fixed times every day of the year, so you always know when your milk and eggs will arrive.

Is there anything added to your milk?

No. Our milk is pure cow milk with no water, no powder and no additives, and it is tested for purity before it leaves the farm.

How do I place an order?

Press any Order Now button, fill in your name, phone number and product, and we will confirm your order with you.

What if I am not happy with my order?

Tell us and we will replace it or refund you. Your satisfaction comes first.

Can I visit the farm?

Yes, you are welcome. Come and see our cows, hens and sheds for yourself. Contact us to arrange a time.
